description:
Beispiel: „Was steht im Lagebericht des letzten Jahresabschlusses?“

Extracted text of ONE Austrian filing document, by its document key. Read-only.

        Parameters:
        - doc_key (required): the document_ref from list_documents (an Austrian filing key).
        - max_chars (optional, default 40000, clamped 1000-120000): truncation ceiling.

        Returns {doc_key, text, truncated, ...} with the filing's Stichtag for citation.
        Austria only today. Use list_documents to discover the key; for the German official
        register abstract use get_document.
name: get_document_text
title: Extract text of a filing document (AT)
